channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: What’s Iran’s 14-point proposal to end the war? And will Trump accept it?
item.description: Iran has sent a 14-point proposal to end the war, but mistrust between the two sides is a significant obstacle. Trump is reviewing the proposal, but no decision has been made.

item.title: Iran sends 14-point plan to end war - as Trump makes fresh threat
item.description: Iran has submitted a 14-point plan to end the war, coinciding with Trump's fresh threat. The proposal's chances of success are uncertain due to the existing mistrust between the two nations.

item.title: Two killed and 16 injured in attempted channel crossing from France to U.K.
item.description: A makeshift boat carrying 65 people ran aground while attempting to cross the English Channel from France to the UK. Seventeen people were rescued by a French maritime gendarmerie vessel and brought to Boulogne-sur-Mer.

item.title: Between a fatwa and war: how Iran makes sense of its nuclear capability
item.description: Iran has vowed to protect its nuclear stockpile despite Trump's threats. The country's former Ayatollah Ali Khamenei previously disapproved of using nuclear weapons on religious grounds. Iran has ‘vowed’ to protect its nuclear stockpile against Trump’s threats even as its former Ayatollah Ali Khamenei disapproved of using nuclear weapons on religious grounds.

item.title: Ukraine drone attack hits Russian Baltic port, governor says
item.description: Ukrainian forces have launched a drone attack on the Russian Baltic port, according to the governor. The attack also targeted two shadow fleet tankers near the port of Novorossiysk, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

item.title: Are Somali pirates on a comeback in 2026?
item.description: Somali pirates are back in 2026 after disappearing in 2013. Somali pirates peaked in 2010, vanished by 2013, and are back in 2026. Are Somali pirates on a comeback in 2026?

item.title: Russian strike kills one as Ukraine launches hundreds of drones
item.description: A Russian strike killed one person in Ukraine. Russia said it intercepted 334 Ukrainian drones overnight across over a dozen regions. Russia said air defence units intercepted and destroyed 334 Ukrainian drones overnight across more than a dozen regions near its western border.

item.title: Iranian supertanker carrying $220m oil cargo slips past US blockade
item.description: An Iranian supertanker carrying $220m worth of oil cargo bypassed a US blockade. The tanker slipped past US forces undetected. Iranian supertanker carrying $220m oil cargo slips past US blockade.

item.title: A Perilous Train Ride Home in Pakistan on the Jaffer Express
item.description: The Jaffer Express train in Pakistan faces crossfire in Balochistan. We witnessed crossfire while waiting for the Jaffer Express, a vital lifeline through Balochistan. For many, it’s the only way home.

item.title: Trump administration approves $8.6 billion arms sales to Middle East amid Iran war deadlock
item.description: The US approved $8.6 billion in arms sales to the Middle East. The sales come amid a deadlock in negotiations over Iran's nuclear program and rising tensions in the region.

item.title: Indian Ship Carrying LPG Transits Hormuz In A Rare Crossing Amid US Blockade
item.description: An Indian ship, Sarv Shakti, carrying LPG, transited the Strait of Hormuz. This was the first observed passage by an India-linked tanker since the US imposed a blockade. Sarv Shakti's journey marks the first observed passage by an India-linked tanker since US blockade.

item.title: 40,000 Attend Illegal Rave Party On French Military Site
item.description: Forty thousand people attended an illegal rave party on a French military site, rooted in anti-establishment culture, as a free party. A free party is usually an illegal form of rave rooted in anti-establishment culture.

item.title: ‘Direct, damning admission of their criminal acts’: Iran after Trump’s ‘pirates’ remark on seizure
item.description: Iran responded to Trump's remark on seizure as a criminal act. ‘Direct, damning admission of their criminal acts’: Iran after Trump’s ‘pirates’ remark on seizure.

item.title: Iran threatens to turn Strait of Hormuz into ‘graveyard’ of US forces
item.description: Iran threatened to turn the Strait of Hormuz into a graveyard. Iran threatens to turn Strait of Hormuz into ‘graveyard’ of US forces.

item.title: North Korea rejects US cybercrime claims as 'absurd slander'
item.description: North Korea rejected US cybercrime claims as absurd slander. North Korea rejects US cybercrime claims as 'absurd slander' dw. com.

item.title: DW News. . For decades, China kept its nuclear arsenal small. Under Xi Jinping, that’s changing
item.description: China is expanding its nuclear arsenal under Xi Jinping, changing its decades-long approach and impacting global security. DW News. For decades, China kept its nuclear arsenal small. Under Xi Jinping, that’s changing fast.

item.title: Norway’s Northern Lights Nightmare
item.description: Norway's northern lights tourism boom has attracted scammers targeting visitors in the Arctic region. This Arctic region has seen a boom in tourism, but as tourists chase the northern lights, scammers chase their money.

item.title: An Insurgency Threatens U.S. Mining Ambitions in Pakistan
item.description: The Baloch Liberation Army's attacks threaten a billion-dollar US-Pakistan mining deal in Pakistan. Attacks by the Baloch Liberation Army could derail Pakistan’s plans for a billion-dollar mining deal with the Trump administration.

item.title: China Invokes First-ever "Blocking Order" Against US Sanctions: Report
item.description: China invoked a "blocking order" to counter US sanctions, neutralising their extraterritorial reach. This legal mechanism marks a first for China, as it seeks to protect its interests from foreign laws.

item.title: Iran Submits 14-Point Peace Plan, Trump Says Deal 'Unlikely'
item.description: Iran submitted a 14-point peace plan to end the war. Trump said a deal is unlikely. US Israel Iran War Ceasefire News LIVE Updates. Iran Submits 14-Point Peace Plan, Trump Says Deal 'Unlikely'.
